ItemId.description: The attempt id, a generated unique id. An attempt with this id is updated.

UserName.description: The user name of the learner. A row whose user is not on the site is reported and skipped.

QuizId.description: The content item id of the quiz.

CourseId.description: The content item id of the course.

EnrollmentId.description: The enrollment the attempt belongs to.

Items.description: The questions as drawn, with their answers, keys and scores: the attempt is a self-contained record.

ScoreHistory.description: The score changes: ChangedUtc, Kind, From, To, Actor or ActorUserName, Reason.

GradedByUserName.description: The user name of the grader.

Attempts.description: The attempts to create, or update by id.

ItemId.description: The override id. An override with this id is updated.

UserName.description: The user name of the learner.

QuizId.description: The content item id of the quiz.

OpensUtc.description: When the quiz opens for this learner, in UTC.

ClosesUtc.description: When the quiz closes for this learner, in UTC.

ActorUserName.description: The user name of the person who gave it.

Overrides.description: The quiz overrides to create, or update by id.

QuizId.description: The content item id of the quiz.

Hash.description: The salted hash of the access code, as exported. The code itself is never exported.

AccessCodes.description: The access codes of quizzes, as hashes.
